updates.title: Pinned technician columns after deactivation or removal from this location
preconditions: You are signed in as {User-A}, an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
A second user {User-B} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C368131 Viewer") has a role with Work orders > View only (Create & Edit off) at {Location-A} and is signed in in a second browser or a private window.
Technician {Technician-A} (for example Esther Howard) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Jenny Pinned) is an active technician at {Location-A}, made for this case only, and leads no work order.

Technician {Technician-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Theresa Pinned) is an active technician at {Location-A} and at a second location {Location-B} (for example Staging Light Duty), made for this case only.
Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C368131 Pinned Gone") is used by this case only.
Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17691) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
Approved work order {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17692) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-C}.
Both {User-A} and {User-B} have {Technician-B} and {Technician-C} pinned in Board View.
No technician has a shift on the Schedule for {Work-order-1} or {Work-order-2}.
On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
steps: Click your initials (top right) and open Settings > Staff.
Click {Technician-B}'s edit icon, click Deactivate Account and confirm.
Click {Technician-C}'s edit icon, remove {Location-A} from her Location field (keep {Location-B}) and click Save.
Click Work Orders in the top menu.
Click the All tab, click Search and type the name of {Customer-A}.
Click Board View in the display switcher.
Read the pinned columns right after Unassigned, including {Technician-B}'s column.
Find {Technician-C}'s column further along and read its header.
Drag {Work-order-1} from {Technician-A}'s column onto {Technician-B}'s column and let go.
Drag {Work-order-1} from {Technician-A}'s column onto {Technician-C}'s column and let go.
Read the message that appears and where {Work-order-1} is.
Drag {Work-order-2} from {Technician-C}'s column onto the Unassigned column and let go.
In the second browser, as {User-B}, open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View.
results: Step 7: {Technician-B}'s column is still shown right after Unassigned, so the pin is kept. It is marked inactive and empty, and it reads "No work orders", not "Drag a work order here to assign it".
Step 7: {Technician-C} is not among the pinned columns.
Step 8: {Technician-C}'s column appears further along as a normal column holding {Work-order-2}, with no pin icon and no inactive marker.
Step 9: the card cannot be dropped on {Technician-B}'s column. {Work-order-1} stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
Steps 10 and 11: the drop is refused with the message "This technician can't be assigned work orders." and {Work-order-1} stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
Step 13: {Work-order-2} is in Unassigned and {Technician-C} no longer has a column at all.
Step 15: for the view-only {User-B}, {Technician-B}'s column also reads "No work orders", and there is no {Technician-C} column.
updates.source: Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician) and SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 49 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R20a, S3-E3, S3-N4, S3-R20b and its context note (Sasha Grosman's answer to SQ-11, 24 Sep 2026), S3-R20c (added in version 49) and S4-N5 (widened in version 49), both from Chris Ward's answer 2 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; read 14 Oct 2026. Sasha Grosman's answer to engineering of 24 Sep 2026 treated a technician who is no longer at this location like an inactive one; PRD version 49 (14 Oct 2026) says that column shows no inactive marker and refuses drops with its own message, and we take the later PRD as prevailing. Source-verified 14 October 2026. This version of the case has not yet been checked against a build (the previous version, updated 9 Oct 2026 for PRD v44, was not re-run on the QA build).
quotes: The empty column of a pinned technician who has been deactivated shows “No work orders” to every user, because nothing can be dropped there (S4-N5).
Retain a technician’s pin after deactivation.
Show an inactive indicator on deactivated technician columns.
A pinned technician who is not enrolled at this location gets no column here. If they still lead work orders at this location, they appear as a normal, unpinned column holding that work.

The column of S3-R20b takes no drops. Dropping a work order on it is refused with "This technician can't be assigned work orders." and the work order stays where it was. The column shows no inactive marker, because the technician is not deactivated (S3-N4). Once it holds no work orders, the column is no longer shown.
Nothing can be dropped onto the column/group of an inactive technician (S2-N2, S3-N2) or of a technician who is not enrolled at this location (S3-R20c).
A pin only counts at locations where the technician is enrolled.
doc_part1: Sign in as an Owner or Admin user. On a QA site click the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". To check the permissions: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders: View and Create & Edit are on.

Pick one location for the whole case; it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (to change it: your initials > Change Location). This is {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). Create everything below at {Location-A}.
Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, with no display switcher).

Your initials > Settings > Staff. Reuse a staff member only if they are active, have Time Clock on, {Location-A} in Location and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User. Otherwise click New Staff Member and enter First Name and Last Name (for example Esther Howard), an Email, Role Technician, Departments Service, Location {Location-A}, turn Time Clock on, then Save & Close. This is {Technician-A}.

Your initials > Settings > Staff. Create a new staff member for this case only (do not reuse a shared one, because this case changes the record): click New Staff Member and enter First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Jenny Pinned), an Email, Role Technician, Departments Service, Location {Location-A}, turn Time Clock on, then Save & Close. This is {Technician-B}.

Your initials > Settings > Staff. Create a new staff member for this case only (do not reuse a shared one, because this case changes the record): click New Staff Member and enter First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Theresa Pinned), an Email, Role Technician, Departments Service, Location {Location-A} and one other location {Location-B} (for example Staging Light Duty), so her Location field is never empty, turn Time Clock on, then Save & Close. This is {Technician-C}.

Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C368131 Pinned Gone") > Save. This is {Customer-A}; use it for this case only. On the customer page click Contacts > New Contact > First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Contact) > Save. Then Assets > New Asset > pick the contact, Year (for example 2022), Make (type "Freight" and pick Freightliner), Model (for example M2), Unit (for example TRK-118) > Save. Contact and Make are required.

Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick {Customer-A} and its asset > Save (if a Confirmation about the credit limit appears, click Create). The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form. In What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service", turn Line Approved on and click Save & Close. The status reads Approved. Write down the number shown at the top left (for example S10043-17691). Repeat this once more. Number them {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2}.
On the work order page pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown; it saves at once. Give {Work-order-1} the lead {Technician-A} and {Work-order-2} the lead {Technician-C}.
Your initials > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C368131 View Role") > turn on Work Orders view, leave Work Orders create and edit off > Save.

Your initials > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member with an email you can open (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C368131 Viewer"), Role = the new role, at least one Department, Location {Location-A} > Save & Close. Accept the invitation email and set a password. This is {User-B}; keep it signed in in a second browser or a private window.

As {User-A}, and again as {User-B}: Work Orders > All tab > Board View. If three technicians are already pinned, unpin one (click the filled pin in its column header), because only three pins are allowed. Click the pin icon in {Technician-B}'s and in {Technician-C}'s column headers (pins are per user).
Do not book any Schedule shift on {Work-order-1} or {Work-order-2}.

Check the setup worked: for both users, Board View shows {Technician-B} and {Technician-C} right after Unassigned with filled pins. Work Orders > All tab > Search with the name of {Customer-A} shows {Work-order-1} led by {Technician-A} and {Work-order-2} led by {Technician-C}. If anything differs, fix it before you start, then clear the search.
doc_part2: Goal: two pinned technicians for both users; during the test one is deactivated ({Technician-B}, leading nothing) and one is removed from {Location-A} ({Technician-C}, still leading {Work-order-2}); then the board is read and three drags are made, and the board is read as a view-only user.
GET /api/staff lists staff; each row has both id and staff_id, and the Schedule's staffId and the working-hours calls use staff_id.

Create {Technician-B} and {Technician-C} new for this case (never deactivate or move a shared technician). Create {Customer-A}, its contact and asset, and {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2} on screen as in Part 1. Record {Work-order-1 id} and {Work-order-2 id}.

{User-B} needs a second browser context with its own sign-in (the invitation and password are set on screen). Quick login signs in only as Admin, so {User-B} must sign in with the email and password; keep the password in /tmp only.
UNVERIFIED on the Work Orders QA site: whether the Location field can be left empty, which is why {Technician-C} is given {Location-B} as well.
Steps 1 to 3 change the staff records during the test; do them on screen as written.

Steps 9 to 12: Playwright drag-and-drop from each card to the target column. Read the message after step 10 exactly and compare it character for character with "This technician can't be assigned work orders." Record where each card ends up and whether any question opened.

Steps 7, 8 and 15: record each column header's text and whether it shows a pin, an inactive marker and the empty-column text. UNVERIFIED: how the build shows the inactive marker (a label or a badge); record what you see.
Context: this case follows PRD version 49 (14 Oct 2026). Nothing about how the build behaves today is assumed; judge only what you see.
Evidence: a screenshot after each step that has an expected result, the build marker, and the real value of every brace name.
updates.change_summary: Rewritten in full to the 8 Oct layout (link, Preconditions with {placeholders}, setup moved to the doc). PRD v49 S3-R20c: {Technician-C}'s column has no inactive marker (step 8) and a drop onto it is refused with "This technician can't be assigned work orders." and the work order stays (steps 10-11); the column goes once empty (step 13, kept). S4-N5 quote refreshed to v49. Kept: deactivated pinned column reads "No work orders" for both users, pin kept (S3-R20a, S3-E3, S3-N4), removed technician not pinned (S3-R20b). Own new ZZAUTOTEST technicians, so no shared staff record is changed and nothing must be restored. Title without the semicolon. Rule 56 divergence sentence on Sasha's 24 Sep answer.
